subject.title: Feature Request: TUI Notification When Agent Completes (Sound/Desktop Alert)

question: Should OpenClaw core own a default-off local TUI completion notification surface, and if so which modes and config shape are acceptable?
rationale: The request adds a new user-facing TUI behavior and config contract, including platform-specific desktop or sound behavior, so automation cannot safely choose the product boundary.

options.title: Approve a narrow TUI notification contract
options.body: Add a default-off TUI completion alert limited to explicit modes such as terminal bell and a safe platform notification backend, with schema/docs/tests before implementation.

options.title: Defer to plugin hooks
options.body: Keep core TUI visual-only and document plugin `agent_end` approaches for users who want custom sounds or alerts outside the TUI contract.

options.title: Wait for session activity API
options.body: Hold this until the broader session activity state work settles, then decide whether TUI completion alerts should consume that contract.

recommendation.title: Approve a narrow TUI notification contract
recommendation.body: Add a default-off TUI completion alert limited to explicit modes such as terminal bell and a safe platform notification backend, with schema/docs/tests before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest current history signal for the TUI completion/status path points to recent work by steipete on handler structure, after-run refresh, and status behavior.
